issues.title: Approved launcher cannot acquire the SC2 runtime lease
issues.description: The first two attempts were blocked by an existing runtime lease. After that owner exited, the final fresh run acquired the lease and passed the complete runtime gate.
issues.impact: No remaining impact on Stage 09 acceptance; stale-port reuse is now rejected by runner preflight.
issues.resolution: Fresh port-5953 run passed with zero-byte launcher.err.log and runtime report runtime_gate=true.

issues.title: P2 native Computer is not an external ML action issuer
issues.description: The runner topology creates P1 participant plus native Computer P2. This is suitable for P1 external policy validation but cannot prove externally controlled P2 ally behavior.
issues.impact: P2 economy, production, and tactical ML control remain unverified.
issues.nextAction: Add a separately authorized participant/API control topology before claiming P2 cooperative ML control.

issues.title: Live bounded reward is a runtime proxy
issues.description: The current raw observation has no mission-specific terminal contract. The runner derives bounded progress from game loop and labels reward as observation-derived runtime proxy.
issues.impact: The live PPO update and bounded rollout cannot establish mission win rate or tactical improvement.
issues.nextAction: Add mission-owned terminal and reward events, then run held-out map/seed evaluation with replay-backed attribution.
